Earlier it was revealed that WhatsApp is developing a brand-new chat theme feature, and this feature has now started rolling out to iPhone users. Details are as follows.

WhatsApp's brand-new chat themes come with dynamic wallpapers

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is now rolling out five brand-new chat theme categories, including Featured, Nature, Dynamic, Minimalist, and Doodle. Two weeks ago, the website had spotted references to a new theme gallery in the code.

The website pointed out that the "Featured" category includes "the best themes carefully selected by the WhatsApp design team"; the "Nature" category "offers themes that bring outdoor scenery into the chat interface"; the "Dynamic" category "features wallpapers that move slowly in the background"; the "Minimalist" themes "apply a clean background to the chat interface: white in light mode and black in dark mode". Finally, the "Doodle" category includes WhatsApp's classic doodle-pattern wallpapers.

The following is WABetaInfo's introduction to the "Dynamic" wallpapers, which is arguably the most eye-catching new feature this time:

WABetaInfo noted that WhatsApp will automatically match the chat bubble colors based on the selected theme, and added that, as with WhatsApp's previous rollout arrangements, the new feature may not be immediately available to all users.
